name: google/gemini-3-flash-preview
description: Gemini 3 Flash Preview is the preview release of the Flash tier in Google's Gemini 3 series, released in December 2025. Google described it at launch as its most powerful agentic and vibe-coding model to that point, built on Gemini 3 reasoning with multimodal understanding across text, image, video, audio and PDF input. It remains a preview endpoint with no announced shutdown date, and Google recommends Gemini 3.6 Flash as its replacement.
